rule: the hand-back is one line and nothing else

edits.old:
One line, the C line's fields in the orchestrator's order, as far as the
round went, and nothing else: no finding's text, no path but the ones the
fields hold, no narration, no notes or bullets before it on what you
could not find or what the orchestrator should know.
edits.new: The C line's fields in the orchestrator's order, as far as the round went.

edits.old:
; a finding's title belongs in the report, not in your
reply.

Your whole
reply is the line: its first character is the backtick that opens the
title and its last is the end of the last field. A check that failed
for information, a commit in the range that is not the chunk's, a
transcript the gate did not find: each is a field's value or a `?`, or
it is not said. The orchestrator reads the last line of what you send
and nothing above it, so a paragraph before the line is read by nobody.
and hand back the chunk's log line and nothing else.
edits.new: and hand back the chunk's log line.
